description: Use when the user asks about power outages or blackouts in the US right now: where, how many customers are out, which utility, estimated restoration. Filter by state and/or utility. Live, by county.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 5 calls free within 48 hours).

min_customers_out.description: Only counties with at least this many customers out.

utility.description: Utility name or part of it.

name: power_outages
title: Live US power outages
